case: versioned destination profiles: source, date, kind, no invented compliance, no silent migration
targets: lib/destination-profiles.mjs profileRecord / profileStatus / complianceNote / checkOutput / pinTarget / migrationOffer / acceptMigration

checks.name: official without a source
checks.expect: recorded kind is assumed_default, downgraded_from is official_requirement, status needs_validation, complianceNote is null

checks.name: official with source and date
checks.expect: state verified; complianceNote names the record and says it is not a platform approval; no field is a 'compliant' badge

checks.name: outdated
checks.setup: same profile checked with now = verified_at + max_age_days + 1
checks.expect: state outdated with a warning; checkOutput still returns warnings only and export stays configurable

checks.name: house preference stays a preference
checks.expect: state house, no needs_validation, never described as a platform rule

checks.name: global update does not move a project
steps: saveProfile(registry, same id with a changed duration max_s)
checks.expect: the pinned target still holds v1 and its digest; migrationOffer lists duration with stage impact (storyboard, build, final stale) and says accepted exports are untouched

checks.name: accepting is explicit
checks.expect: first call changes nothing; second re-pins and records previous profile id, version and digest

checks.name: unknown destination
checks.expect: profile is custom-unknown / assumed with needs_validation true and a warning; no compliance text
